scripts.dev: concurrently -n "web,api" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api && uv run --directory apps/ai ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && uv run --directory apps/ai mypy .
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w apps/api && uv run --directory apps/ai pytest
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
